name: Postie Bike
summary: Refined the CB50-inspired delivery motorcycle with an octagonal cylinder/cooling fins, curved single right header, rounded tank inset ends and bevelled saddle, continuous tapered arms, shaped hi-vis vest with attached bands, cheek-returning face and arched visor/chin lip. Spoked wheel openings remain real. Exported triangles: 2669 / 894 / 599 within original 2900 / 900 / 600 budgets. Original physics inputs, anchors, hinges and material stay frozen. Weighted silhouette .8563 to .8501 / .8241 to .8210 / .8049 to .7932 regresses; local helmet curvature improves and its new gate rejects the actual baseline at every tier. The primary CB50 image governs one right pipe despite generated contradictions. Review candidate below the ~.95 global target.
